P Promotional cards matter because they show Pokemon's early-2000s assembly as a social machine: airlines, magazines, tournaments, fast food counters, fan clubs, movie releases, city stores, and rallies all become card routes. The printed NNN/P number is the thin line that keeps that social route from dissolving into generic promo fog.
